title: Container With Most Water
statement:
height[i] is the height of a vertical line at position i. Pick two lines; together with the x-axis they form a container. Return the largest area of water a container can hold (area = distance between the lines * the shorter height).

Example: [1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7] -> 49
Example: [1,1] -> 1
